span 56) references the 2012 Abstract for summit elevation. U.S. Highpoint Guide (span 28) states Louisiana's lowest point is below sea level, consistent with the 8-foot elevation claim. The 2012 U.S. Statistical Abstract (original source) lists these values as recorded.
